## Task 1 — Patient Documents: filter pills fix

**Problem:** "My Documents & Reports" screen par saare filter buttons (All, Signed
Consent Forms, Clinical Records, Medical Letters, Lab & Diagnostics, Prescriptions,
Other) kaam nahi kar rahe the.

**Root cause:** Do bugs ek saath —
1. Filter stored category ko pill ke apne label text se compare kar raha tha — "Clinical
   Records" (plural) kabhi stored "Clinical Record" se match nahi karta, isliye screen blank.
2. Shared table layer har re-render par row visibility search query se overwrite kar raha
   tha, filter ka result mita deta tha.
3. Search box `onkeyup` par tha jabki shared layer `input` event sunta hai.

**Fix:** Har pill ko explicit `data-doc-filter` token list di, `window.diorStaticRowPredicate`
hook add kiya, empty-state row add kiya, `onkeyup` → `oninput`.

**Buckets review:** "Signed Consent Forms" remove kiya (Clinical Records ka duplicate),
"Lab & Diagnostics" → "Lab & Scans" rename kiya, Other mein Procedure/ID Proof/Other.

**Commit:** `084f4ac`

## Task 4 — HIPAAtizer booking popup premature trigger

**Problem:** Intake form mein Continue dabane par "Schedule Telehealth Appointment"
popup khul jata tha, jabki wo sirf final submit ke baad khulna chahiye.

**Investigation:** Pehle sirf analysis maangi thi — "code mat karo, pehle check karo
plugin ka bug hai ya mera".

**Findings — 3 defects:**

1. **`dior-hipaatizer-popup.js` ka click listener dead code tha.** Wo sirf page ke apne
   document ke clicks par chalta hai; intake form cross-origin iframe mein hai, isliye
   uska Next/Submit click wahan pahunchta hi nahi. Aur page ke saare "Book An
   Appointment" buttons `#dior-patient-portal-app` ke andar hain jo
   `isAppointmentButton()` khud exclude karta tha.

2. **Asli wajah: completion matcher bahut dheela tha.** `dior-dashboard.js` aur
   `dior-docbooker-modal.js` dono mein alag-alag list thi, aur koi bhi `origin` check
   nahi tha. `submitted` word aane par hi "form complete" maan liya jata tha — jo
   HIPAAtizer har step save par bhejta hai.

3. **Do live renderer.** Same workflow do jagah render hota hai (tab form +
   hidden footer copy), isliye har step par do messages aate the.

**Fixes (3 commits):**

- `ca5e95e` — terminal events ki allowlist, origin check, once-only guard
- `066c312` — single shared detector `window.diorHipaatizerCompletion()`, visibility
  gate (sirf wahi form instance jo patient dekh raha hai), dashboard.js delegate
- `f7599ad` — **reproduced real bug:** `{step:1, completed:true}` bhi modal khol deta
  tha. Ab step payloads reject, bare `completed` flag no longer accepted.

**Saath mein:** `dior-hipaatizer-popup.js` ka version hardcoded `DIOR_PORTAL_VERSION`
tha — upload ke baad bhi purana file cache se chalta rehta tha. Ab `filemtime` use
karta hai (`dior-medical-dashboard.php`).

## Verification

- Documents filter: saare pills, filter+search combination, empty-state — browser test
- Filter removal: search (`proced` → 1 row), pagination (10/page, 11–20 of 21)
- Scheduler card: markup gone, intake form intact, no console errors
- HIPAAtizer: **12/12 scenarios pass**

| Scenario | Result |
|---|---|
| Step 1/2/Next/intermediate saves | No popup, screen advance nahi hoti |
| Final submit | Exactly 1 popup, dashboard 1 baar advance |
| Duplicate completion (2 copies + retry) | Sirf 1 popup |
| Hidden footer renderer alone | No popup, latch consume nahi hota |
| Form inside popup slot | Correctly opens |
| Failed / validation error | No popup |
| Foreign origin | Nothing |
| Dashboard refresh | No popup |
| Registration flow (`?intake_required=1`) | Unchanged |

**Payload-level test:** 11 step shapes → nothing; 7 terminal shapes → exactly one popup.
